event.description: Replace learned absolute positions with fixed sinusoidal encoding; parameterization-preserving positional representation substitution.
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100.000000%, a +1.000000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no prior accepted or failed result; 0 prior attempts. Hypothesis: fixed sinusoidal position features preserve the alignment signal required by reversed addition while eliminating the learned 35x16 table (560 parameters). This is a representational change, not merely a parameterization-preserving compression. This repairs the unlogged infrastructure failure in the first launch before any train/verify evidence. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative, deleting position information entirely, because it separates learned position capacity from the need for an ordering signal.
